newsitem.title: UK: Ofwat says commercial firm switches water supplier.
newsitem.headline: Ofwat says commercial firm switches water supplier.

text.p: British water industry regulator Ofwat said on Wednesday a company which processes and packages fresh chickens had become the first commercial company to switch its water supplier.

Buxted Chicken Ltd in Suffolk, south-east England, is switching to Anglian Water Plc from its current supplier Essex & Suffolk Water Plc, and expects to save around 50,000 stg per year on its water bill.

"This is an important step in introducing more competition into the water industry," Ian Byatt, director general of water services, said in a statement. "I hope other large users will be encouraged by this move".
